root_cause: In importlib mode, import_path() creates and executes a new module even when its name is already present in sys.modules, replacing the cached object. Existing references retain the previous module and its classes, splitting initialization state. insert_missing_modules() preserves existing parent attributes, which can also retain stale references. This establishes a duplication mechanism consistent with the report, but not the specific pmxbot trigger.

root_cause: HTTPAdapter.send translates SSL and read-timeout exceptions but re-raises other urllib3 HTTPError subclasses unchanged. Consequently, a base urllib3 TimeoutError or DecodeError reaching this handler escapes the Requests exception API. The actual proxy-timeout scenario is not reproduced; normal response streaming already translates DecodeError into ContentDecodingError.
